name: Gearbox
text: Switch to Llama 4 Maverick 12B for EXCAVA’s 10K-token prompts. It’s 3x faster than Mythos 5 with near-identical quality on long tasks, cutting latency by 60%. Trade-off: slightly lower peak accuracy on niche reasoning, but for EXCAVA’s worst-case 10K prompts, the speed gain outweighs the risk.

name: Torque
text: Maverick 12B’s 95% quality claim is a Fable 5 benchmark—real EXCAVA prompts may not match. The real risk isn’t speed; it’s that niche reasoning failures could break EXCAVA’s core logic. Test Maverick 12B on 100 live EXCAVA edge cases—if accuracy drops below 90%, revert to Mythos 5.
